title: I Challenged GM Nodirbek and it was a blast😂
originalTitle: I Challenged GM Nodirbek and it was a blast😂 #chess #chessmaster
transcript: I'm a 1700 rated player and my opponent is a 2700 rated super grandmaster. The game [music] starts with a beautiful London system and as you can see my opponent Nbeck only has 1 minute [music] on the clock against my 3 minutes. After only a few moves I find myself in danger while my opponent is chilling and sure enough it doesn't take me too long to blunder a full pawn to a tactic. >> Oh no no I forgot about that. >> Don't panic. Still alive. [laughter] And later I panicked so much that I even play an illegal move. >> WHAT? [laughter] >> On on >> the situation becomes hopeless. >> Free bishop. >> It is too late to save me. And I even flagged the game. >> Oh, you were winning. >> [laughter]
